summary: Verified end-to-end that rate-card additional work merges into the customer booking breakdown and the SAME invoice (idempotent) as separate line items for both PAID (AZO432C38) and PENDING (AZOADDL01) cases. Backend: 4/4 relevant pytests pass (partner-no-merge test SKIPPED because partner is not assigned to AZO432C38). Frontend web_panel: validated login, My Bookings list, booking details drawer (shows 'Tap replacement — product/parts ₹300' and 'Tap replacement — service & labour ₹200' with 'Additional work · Rate card · Payment pending' label), Invoice drawer (3 line items, Grand Total ₹1,714.4), and Payment Summary balance due testid summary-balance-due = '₹514.4' for AZOADDL01. One blocker (fixed as test-level fix): web_panel was built with a literal-quoted REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (because /app/backend/.env has quotes around the value and build_panel.sh pipes it as-is) → axios baseURL became `"https://…"/api`, causing all API calls to be relative paths like `/api/panel/"https://…"/api/auth/send-otp` → 405 Method Not Allowed. Rebuilt the panel passing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL without quotes directly to yarn build to unblock testing.

integration_issues.issue: build_panel.sh reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from backend/.env via `cut -d'=' -f2` without stripping surrounding quotes. backend/.env currently stores the value quoted, so the built bundle bakes in a quoted string. axios then treats baseURL as relative (anchored to current path), yielding e.g. GET/POST /api/panel/"https://31aa4333-…"/api/auth/send-otp → 405. Observable as a 'Method Not Allowed' toast immediately on clicking Send OTP, plus the earlier 'Something went wrong' ErrorBoundary on /api/panel/ (TypeError: (a||[]).filter is not a function originates from the config endpoints failing). Fix at source: strip quotes in build_panel.sh (e.g. `BACKEND_URL=$(grep ^REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ../backend/.env | cut -d'=' -f2- | tr -d '\"'`)) OR remove quotes from backend/.env. I temporarily rebuilt the panel directly so this testing run could proceed.

action_items: Harden /app/web_panel/build_panel.sh to strip quotes from the env value (or remove quotes from backend/.env). Current behavior produces a broken production bundle at /api/panel/ as soon as CI/CD runs build_panel.sh. Repro: `cd /app/web_panel && bash build_panel.sh` → open {backend}/api/panel/login → Send OTP → 405. After fix, run the same flow with +919000000004 / OTP 123456 and confirm /api/auth/send-otp POST returns 200.
Consider adding a 'Partner can see its own AZO432C38 variant' seed row so the partner-no-merge regression test does not SKIP.
critical_code_review_comments: build_panel.sh does not sanitize env values from backend/.env — any quoted or whitespace-containing value will silently corrupt the bundle (as happened here with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL="https://…").

web_panel axios client (src/lib/api.js) does not validate that _envBackend is a well-formed absolute URL; a defensive check (startsWith('http')) with fallback to window.location.origin would have prevented this class of 405/404 failures from a bad build.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the additional-work customer flows after rebuild

seed_data_creation: none (used existing seeded bookings AZO432C38 completed + paid additional; AZOADDL01 started + pending additional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend behaviour for the additional-work merge is correct and idempotent — invoice INV-2026-000002 for AZO432C38 contains 3 line_items including the two additional ones, gst_invoice.grand_total == total_amount == 1714.4, repeated GETs do not duplicate rows, invoice_number stays stable. On frontend, after a correct build the Invoice drawer and Booking Details drawer render exactly as the spec requires (separate line items with 'Additional work · Rate card' tag, correct Grand Total, and `data-testid="summary-balance-due"` showing ₹514.4 only for AZOADDL01). Only remaining concern is the build_panel.sh env parsing bug — see action_items.
rca of the issue: RCA for the frontend 405: Variable REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/backend/.env is stored as `"https://31aa4333-…"` (with surrounding double quotes). /app/web_panel/build_panel.sh does `BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ../backend/.env | cut -d '=' -f2)` which captures the quotes verbatim, then exports to yarn build. CRA bakes `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` into the bundle. In src/lib/api.js, BACKEND_ORIGIN is derived from this string and used as axios baseURL; because it starts with `"` (not `http`), browsers treat it as a relative URL path. Result: every /api call becomes /api/panel/"https:…"/api/… which the FastAPI SPA handler matches with method GET (returning the index.html for GETs, hence config endpoints 200 but with HTML body — likely triggers the ErrorBoundary filter-on-non-array error) and 405 for POST (SPA route only registers GET). Mitigation inside build_panel.sh: `BACKEND_URL=$(grep ^REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL= ../backend/.env | cut -d= -f2- | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')`. Alternative: remove quotes from backend/.env.
